version.changelog:
- Added comprehensive educational framework for international communication and digital media management.
- Introduced clear learning objectives including editorial review, distribution planning, translation, discoverability, monitoring, workflow coordination, and ethics.
- Included recommended workflow and quality checklist to guide practical application.
- Provided detailed, structured explanations of topics such as editorial review, distribution, language adaptation, search discoverability, and cross-cultural communication.
- Emphasized evidence-based communication, transparency, and responsible handling of data.
